Researcher | Hardware Designer

Mohd Faisal Khan

I am a PhD scholar at IIT Indore, specializing in algorithm-hardware co-design for edge intelligence.

I build efficient, low-power AI accelerator architectures for FPGA and ASIC deployment, with a focus on mixed-precision computing and practical edge systems.

Explore my research and achievements →

Research interests

  • Low-power AI hardware accelerator architectures
  • Algorithm–hardware co-design and mixed-precision computing
  • VLSI circuit and system design for high-performance digital architectures
  • Physical design automation and RTL-to-GDSII implementation
  • EDA flows and optimization for ASIC and FPGA platforms
